claims.statement: Simic is the green-blue guild of Ravnica, associated with biological research, adaptation, medicine, and experimental improvement.
The guide frames Simic philosophy through the Holdfast and the Upwelling: rooted natural connection and constant improvement.
The guide describes Simic members as scientists, physicians, surgeons, and maintainers of Ravnica's public health.
The guide says Simic members are organized into clades, each handling different aspects of Simic society and biological research.
The 2019 guide presents Prime Speaker Vannifar as current Prime Speaker after Zegana and describes her Adaptionist philosophy.
Adapt is the Ravnica Allegiance signature mechanic associated with Simic.
Simic placement signals should weight curiosity about living systems, improvement, adaptation, experimentation, and managed evolution.
claims.notes: Placement inference derived from official faction identity and mechanics; not an official Wizards psychological taxonomy.
